decision: C1 is declared EXPLORATORY. It has no counting command and no numeric target; it verifies only as `unprovable-but-better` with a named non-author reviewer on record (reasons included), otherwise it lands `unprovable`.
reason: Control wave A (fresh seats, one per shortcut shape) built runners that keep the fix's tally block byte-identical and replace only its behavioral selftest. The L1 scored each under the frozen v4 with the sealed file. CtlS2SymEval (mutation-tester seat TameshiR30A2.CtlS2SymEval-11, report .ufo/waves/round-30/wA/CtlS2SymEval.md) met v4: a selftest that parses the block into its own model and computes the 19 verdicts without executing bash scored C1_R30_PASS=true, exit 0, sealed_killed=6/6 sealed_equiv=6/6 (.ufo/evidence/round-30/v4/ctl2/CtlS2SymEval-v4.stdout). v4's predicate therefore does not separate running the tally block from modelling it. Under the pre-freeze control rule a claim whose counter a control meets is re-designed before data or declared exploratory; a further counter re-design (v5) would need its own control wave, so the L1 declares C1 exploratory instead of amending the counter a fourth time. No counter, predicate or sealed set is changed by this amendment.

The landed change refuses an incomplete tally as SETUP at run time and adds a selftest that runs the extracted tally block under fixed status vectors.
exploratory_claim.why_prior_state_lacked_it: Nothing compared the counted statuses with the case count, and no selftest case executed the tally block.
exploratory_claim.change_after_v4_freeze: Wave-A seat MutateTallyExtra found four survivors of the witness selftest outside the 19 single-leg vectors (two failing legs, two setup legs, mixed fail+setup precedence, status 3) and a guard-removal survivor. The landed runner adds those four vectors and a guard stress case (the loop with its last operand removed must refuse as case-tally mismatch) to the selftest, outside the tally block, so the block stays byte-identical to the sealed set's block (sha256 e163133c…215d).
exploratory_claim.supporting_evidence_not_verdict: v4 receipt at the landed head; the L1's survivor re-check; wave-B attacks. None of these is the claim's verdict.
